decisions.reason: A flagship product line close to the firm's core dental software knowledge, backed by in-house R&D, lets the firm learn from results and keep improving it.
The education institute builds on the firm's training content and practitioner relationships, so it fits existing knowledge and supports customer retention.
Remote support draws directly on the firm's customer support capabilities and is low-cost to maintain within the established service offer.
Practice analytics extends the firm's practice management data and software expertise, fitting its digital practice direction.
The complete practice bundle packages the core offer the firm knows well, making it easy to interpret its results and refine it.

A job and practice listing portal lies distant from the firm's software know-how, which raises the risk of dropping it, but its low cost and its link to the dental community make keeping it somewhat more likely.
